purpose: End-to-end configuration and execution acceptance, not a price-policy superiority experiment
boundaries: paper15 is the repository's synthetic terminal-only reference feeder, not an original published field feeder
Residential consumption replaces original mixed DER profiles; original graph and reference impedance scale1 retained
Three measured control households per terminal; no outcome-dependent mapping or magnitude rescaling
Planning uses mean forecast and provisional training-only response factors; D-opt is an ordinary comparison baseline, not a new WZZT score
Held-out aggregate treatment/control trajectories form a semi-synthetic response simulator, not measured individual counterfactuals
One joint full-day factor per menu is common across offered nodes; individual node differences come from actual loads and assigned prices
Q follows synthetic residential power factor; no empirical Q/V measurements claimed
Budget is1000NOK per24-hour terminal-aggregator settlement; repeat validation session uses same assignment and its own identical cap
45kW is a declared terminal contract capacity, not a verified line thermal rating
Validation day selects WZZT path, so validation voltage error is not an untouched predictive-test result
All failures, physical violations, and incomplete solver statuses retained; no clipping or increased retry budget
